basic_info.description: Spacious single family home in San Francisco's desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood. The main level features a large kitchen, living-dining room combo, two generous bedrooms, full bathroom with both bathtub and stall shower, ample storage and abundant natural light throughout. The lower level consists of a family room with wet bar, additional bedroom, full bathroom with stall shower, washer and dryer hookups, and access to the backyard. The expansive back yard is ideal for gardening, kids play, or large gatherings alike. Conveniently located within walking distance to Ocean Beach, San Francisco Zoo, the Taraval Street shopping corridor with easy light rail access, various other transportation lines, Lakeshore Plaza an abundance of restaurants, shopping, and much more!
